title: fix(app-shell): the console AI dock names the selected app and the page in view in its chat request (#30043)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HPQri8yJvYhNpGXfbb2mtPTE)_

Part of #30043. The card carries no `Claim:` naming this branch, so the closing-target guard would refuse a closing keyword here; the dispatching seat closes the card after this lands (or posts the claim and switches this line to a closing keyword).

## What changes

The console's AI chat request (`POST /api/v1/ai/agents/:agent/chat`) now names the app the user has selected and the page in view, on every chat surface, the floating dock included.

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (`ChatPane`): `context.activeApp` is no longer the constant `'AI'`. It is the selected app's package: the new `activeAppPackageId` prop (the console app the dock sits in), else `editPackageId` (the app picked for editing on `/ai/build?package=…`, the Studio copilot's package). With neither, the key is omitted. The `surfaceContext` prop takes the shared `ChatSurfaceContext` type, which adds cloud#1610's existing `selection` key to the client side.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/chatSurfaceContext.ts` (new): `consoleChatSurface(pathname, hostPaths)` reads the page in view off the URL into cloud#1610's shape. It matches against `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS`, the route table `AppContent` is held equal to, ranked the way `<Routes>` ranks it, so a static route (`search`, `reports`) or a host route never reads as an object.
  - object list, data, new: `{ artifact: { type: 'object', name } }`; a saved list view adds `selection: { kind: 'view', id }`
  - record page (and its edit form and named record pages): `{ artifact: { type: 'object', name }, selection: { kind: 'record', id } }`
  - dashboard, report, page: `{ artifact: { type, name } }`; the dashboard designer adds `mode: 'design'`
  - anything else (app landing, search, component pages, metadata admin, redirects): no `surface`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx`: computes the dock's surface from `location.pathname` each render and hands it, with the object's translated label for the "discussing" chip, to both dock presentations (desktop rail and phone sheet). `AppContent` passes its host route paths in.
- `ChatDock.tsx` / `ChatDockConversation.tsx`: forward `surfaceContext` / `surfaceArtifactLabel`, and pass the console app's package as `activeAppPackageId` whichever agent the dock runs.
- `useObjectChat.transportIdentity.test.tsx`: the fixture no longer models `activeApp: 'AI'`.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Why

objectstack#30043 (the objectstack half of cloud#3564). Measured on staging by scripting the dock's own body on an object list page: `{activeApp:"AI", agentName:"build", autoPublishAiBuilds:true, packageId:"app.jpph"}`. The agent was told the user was in "AI" and was never told the page or record, so "who owns this record?" was answered with "please give me the record's name", and "how do I use this app?" was answered for another app. How the agent uses these fields is cloud#3564's half.

The value is read per send: `useObjectChat` reads `body` through a ref at send time (pinned since objectui#4187), and the dock's pane is keyed on the conversation, not on the page, so navigating with the dock open moves the next turn's context without remounting the pane.

## Verification

- `ChatDock.requestContext-30043.test.tsx` (new): real `ConsoleLayout`, real dock (rail and sheet), real lazy `ChatDockConversation`, real `ChatPane`, real `useObjectChat`; the pinned value is the JSON body of the POST captured off a `fetch` stub. Six cases: record page (activeApp + object + record id), object list page (the measured page), build agent bound to the app (activeApp = packageId), navigation with the dock open (list → record → search drops the key), no app selected (no `activeApp`, no `'AI'` anywhere), phone sheet. With `AiChatPage.tsx` and `ChatDockConversation.tsx` put back to `origin/main` on the committed tree, all 6 fail (`expected 'AI' to be 'app.crm'`, `expected undefined to deeply equal { artifact … }`, `expected { activeApp: 'AI', … } to not have property "activeApp"`); restored, all 6 pass.
- `chatSurfaceContext-30043.test.ts` (new): 8 cases over the route mapping, including decoded segments, static and host routes that shadow `:objectName`, and a guard that every mapped path is a route the console declares.
- Local, on `1aa3407a`: the two new files plus every `layout/__tests__/ChatDock*`, `layout/__tests__/ConsoleLayout*`, `console/ai/__tests__/*` and the Studio copilot tests: 65 files, 368 tests, all pass. `useObjectChat.transportIdentity.test.tsx`: 5/5.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check`: NOT MEASURED locally (this container has not built the `@object-ui/*` declaration closure, so tsc reports unresolved modules across the whole package, untouched files included). `Type Check UI` in CI is the reading.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Acceptance notes

- **Record name is not sent.** The card's Do 2 lists "object + record id + record name" and also says "use the existing cloud#1610 shape; do not add a second one". That shape (`ToolExecutionContext.surfaceContext` in the spec, and cloud's `sanitizeSurfaceContext`) has no slot for a record's display name: `selection` is `{ kind, id }`, and cloud drops any other key. A name also has no race-free source in the dock today: the record page publishes its title to `NavigationContext` unkeyed, and `RecordDetailView` keeps the previous record's title until the next record loads, so a name read there could pair record B's id with record A's name. This PR sends the object and the record id, which the agent's `get_record` resolves. Carrying the name needs a spec key (e.g. `selection.label`) plus an id-keyed title channel; that is the seat's call.
- **activeApp is a package id**, as the card asks ("the same value as `packageId`"). The cloud agent route does not read `context.activeApp` today (only `appName`, `objectName`, `recordId`, `viewName`, `surface`, `packageId`), so this half changes what is sent; reading it is cloud#3564's half.
- **Console apps without a `_packageId`** send no `activeApp` (pinned): nothing is selected by package, and no placeholder is sent.
- The dock's "discussing" chip now appears on object, record, dashboard, report and page routes. On object pages it reads the object's translated label; on dashboards, reports and pages it reads `type · name` (the dock does not load those buckets just to label a chip).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI `Lint UI` is the reading.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
